summary: This benchmark evaluates direct MLX tensor gathers against full NumPy array materialization for a 192³ cell boundary-and-witness estimator on Apple Silicon. Direct sampling delivers a 4.13× median speedup (reducing pooled latency from 7.05 ms to 1.68 ms) while maintaining exact decision equivalence across all 48 test frames. The methodology is statistically sound and well-documented with rigorous controls, though the scope is restricted to isolated selector logic on synthetic frames.
strengths: Rigorous statistical controls including frame warming, 12 alternating repetitions, and 5,000 bootstrap draws across 8 complete world seeds.
Strict functional verification demonstrating 100% equivalence (48/48 frames matching all boundary coordinates and witness axes).
Precise specification of hardware (Apple M5 Ultra, 256 GiB) and software environment (Python 3.12.16, MLX 0.32.4, NumPy 2.5.5).
Clear separation between the timed sparse evaluation pipeline and external simulation operations (dense frame generation and line indexing).
weaknesses: Evaluated purely on synthetic detector frames rather than full end-to-end domain simulation workloads.
Lacks exploration across varying grid dimensions (e.g., scaling below or above 192³) to determine where the gather overhead crosses over full materialization.
Direct repo artifact review was restricted due to submission being processed as text-only badge.
suggestions: Include a scaling curve across different tensor resolutions (e.g., 64³, 128³, 256³, 512³) to document the crossover point where tensor gathers outperform materialization.
Benchmark memory residency and peak allocation deltas alongside execution latency to quantify unified memory footprint benefits.
Provide end-to-end wall-clock impacts within the broader transport and readout pipeline mentioned in the discussion.

claims.text: The baseline converts all 7,077,888 detector values into a NumPy array
The direct path gathers 36,864 line readings from the MLX tensor
claims.source: Geometric verification: 64 stratified lines * 192 cells * 3 orthogonal axes = 36,864 sampled elements

claims.text: Hardware was an arm64 Apple M5 Ultra with 256 GiB unified memory
Pooled median latency was 7.05 ms versus 1.68 ms
claims.source: Arithmetic check: 7.05 ms / 1.68 ms = 4.196×, matching the reported 4.13× paired world speedup distribution
